system: MechMaker Solar System Planetary Mining Network

mining_nodes.name: Marianas Abyss Extraction Rig
mining_nodes.description: Deep ocean seabed crawls at 11,000 meters depth extracting polymetallic nodules and high-purity cobalt-azure crusts under extreme hydrostatic pressure.

mining_nodes.name: Lake Baikal Sub-Rift Sills
mining_nodes.description: Terran Hegemony foundational metallurgical strip mines tapping continental rift magma sills rich in dense structural iron, chrome, and tungsten.

mining_nodes.name: Shackleton Crater Cryo-Rim
mining_nodes.description: Permanently shadowed crater trap harboring ancient volatile ice and solar-wind implanted Helium-3 aneutronic fusion fuel.

mining_nodes.name: Oceanus Procellarum Thorium Shelf
mining_nodes.description: KREEP-rich basalt terrain yielding immense reserves of Thorium-232 and rare earth yttrium flux for high-temp superconductor matrices.

mining_nodes.name: Olympus Mons Magma Conduit
mining_nodes.description: Massive geothermal tap descending into the throat of the Solar System tallest volcano; rich in heavy chrome-vanadium and vulcanizing sulfur.

mining_nodes.name: Valles Marineris Fault Trench
mining_nodes.description: Deep tectonic canyon walls exposing billions of years of mineral stratification, yielding high-grade copper, lithium salars, and boron nitrides.

mining_nodes.name: Phobos Stickney Crater Foundry
mining_nodes.description: Low-gravity slag processing center capturing passing Martian orbital freighters; produces pure carbonaceous graphene nanotubes.

mining_nodes.name: 16 Psyche Protoplanetary Core
mining_nodes.description: An exposed metallic planetary core worth quadrillions; solid iron-nickel alloy intergrown with ultra-dense osmiridium and platinum group slabs.

mining_nodes.name: Ceres Occator Brine Cryo-Geyser
mining_nodes.description: Sodium carbonate salt domes and bright faculae fed by sub-surface hydrothermal brine chambers; primary source of synthetic flux bases.

mining_nodes.name: Vesta Rheasilvia Central Peak
mining_nodes.description: Differentiated asteroid peak exposing deep crustal pyroxenes and high-tensile molybdenum-tungsten reserves for heavy ballistic chassis.

mining_nodes.name: Io Pele Hyper-Caldera Tap
mining_nodes.description: Lethal radiation belts bathe robotic rigs extracting refractory hafnium, tantalum, and rhenium from molten silicate volcanic vents.

mining_nodes.name: Europa Conamara Chaos Sub-Vent
mining_nodes.description: Thermal drill probes breach 20 kilometers of ice crust to tap abyssal hydrothermals rich in heavy xenon propellant and gallium-indium alloys.

mining_nodes.name: Callisto Valhalla Outer Rings
mining_nodes.description: Apex Zaibatsu heavily fortified deep-space logistics megafoundry, strip-mining ancient multi-ring impact basins for military tungsten and uranium.

mining_nodes.name: Titan Kraken Mare Liquid Harvester
mining_nodes.description: Offshore semi-submersible rigs refining endless seas of liquid hydrocarbons into ultra-dense graphene sheets and cryo-nitrogen coolant.

mining_nodes.name: Saturn B-Ring Ice-Barge Sieve
mining_nodes.description: Automated sieve-dredges filtering ring particles for deuterium-rich water-ice and solar wind noble gases in planetary shadow.

mining_nodes.name: Sedna Deep-Mantle Void Anomaly
mining_nodes.description: At the freezing edge of interstellar space, a primordial trans-Neptunian anomaly yields ultra-rare Island of Stability super-heavy elements.
